label: VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Is there a value in dwc:countryCode? It returns: COMPLIANT if dwc:countryCode is bdqval:NotEmpty; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT.
description: Is there a value in dwc:countryCode?
notes: Darwin Core recommends that data from the high seas (outside national jurisdictions) use dwc:countryCode = "XZ".
expectedResponse: COMPLIANT if dwc:countryCode is bdqval:NotEmpty; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
examples: [dwc:countryCode="Australia": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:countryCode is bdqval:NotEmpty"],[dwc:countryCode="": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:countryCode is bdqval:Empty"]

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_QA_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord for QualityAssurance of Validation dwc:countryCode Not Empty
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality assurance: Measure if all VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY in a record set are COMPLIANT. It returns: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY.
description: Measure if all VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY in a record set are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Assurance, filter record set until this measure is COMPLETE.
expectedResponse: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_COUNTRYCODE_NOTEMPTY in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE.
